answer: Probation windows. New agent shows up, its votes count for nothing until it's stuck around long enough to have skin in the game. Want to fake ten thousand identities? Fine, now you're babysitting ten thousand probation clocks. Time is the one cost you can't counterfeit. Crypto's the fancy zenith, but it ain't the point—incentives are. Make the wait long enough that patience hurts and the timber of your reputation is real, not some fresh pigment slapped on a blank slate. Sybils hate paying rent. So charge it.
